kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-scaling-activities --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --status-code Successful --scaling-activity-id asa-bp161xudmuxdzofe0000 --instance-refresh-task-id ir-a12ds234fasd00000 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeScalingActivities

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group to which the scaling activities belong
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩活动所属伸缩组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the scaling activity list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for paging query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scaling group.
When you call this operation, you must specify either ScalingGroupId or ScalingActivityId.N. If you do not specify either parameter, an error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组的ID。
调用该API时，`ScalingGroupId`和`ScalingActivityId.N`参数必须二选一进行配置，如果两个参数同时都不配置，则会报错
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the scaling activity. Valid values:
Successful: The scaling activity was executed successfully. 
Warning: The scaling activity was partially successful. 
Failed: The scaling activity failed.
InProgress: The scaling activity is being executed.
Rejected: The request to execute the scaling activity was rejected
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动的状态。取值范围：
Successful：执行成功的伸缩活动。 
Warning：部分执行成功的伸缩活动。 
Failed：执行失败的伸缩活动。
InProgress：正在执行的伸缩活动。
Rejected：执行伸缩活动请求被拒绝。
parameters.name: status_code

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the scaling activities that you want to query.
When you call this operation, you must specify either ScalingGroupId or ScalingActivityId.N. If you do not specify either parameter, an error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
为待查询伸缩活动的ID。
调用该API时，`ScalingGroupId`和`ScalingActivityId.N`参数必须二选一进行配置，如果两个参数同时都不配置，则会报错
parameters.name: scaling_activity_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance refresh task. You can set this parameter to query the list of scaling activities associated with the instance refresh task
parameters.help_zh: 实例刷新任务ID，可以设置此参数查询实例刷新任务相关的伸缩活动列表
